spans.s: ज्यैष्ठः [jyaiṣṭhḥ], N. of a lunar month in which the full moon stands in the constellation ज्येष्ठा (corresponding to May-June).
ष्ठी The full-moon day in the month of ज्यैष्ठ
ज्यैष्ठिनेय [jyaiṣṭhinēya], a. Born from the eldest or principal wife; कृते कनिष्ठिनेयस्य ज्यैष्ठिनेयं विवासितम्
ज्यैष्ठ्यम् [jyaiṣṭhyam], Precedence, priority of birth, primogeniture, seniority.
